title: Lower Challenge
description: Legs and core challenge: isometric squats, paused lunges and dynamic plank work

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Jog in place, heels kicking toward glutes

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + thoracic rotation + arm reaching to the sky

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: Isometric squat
exercises.instructions: Hold the bottom squat position without moving

exercises.name: Paused lunges
exercises.instructions: Lower and hold 3s at the bottom before standing

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.instructions: On one leg, lean torso forward, back leg extended

exercises.name: Plank to downward dog
exercises.instructions: Alternate between high plank and downward dog position

exercises.name: Russian twists
exercises.instructions: Seated, feet off the floor, rotate torso left and right

exercises.name: Hollow hold
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs extended above the floor, lower back pressed down

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
